repos.what: Native timeline editor (Premiere-like) that can generate clips with models such as Seedance/Kling inside the timeline, and lets Claude/Codex/Cursor edit the project over MCP. Needs macOS 26 on Apple Silicon. Later releases are no longer GPLv3.

howTo.value: Open the app, then connect your agent to its local MCP server:
claude mcp add --transport http palmier-pro http://127.0.0.1:19789/mcp

repos.reachFor: You want an agent to edit a real timeline project on a Mac instead of rendering from code.

repos.name: openwhispr
repos.oneLiner: Hotkey voice dictation with local Whisper/Parakeet or BYOK cloud
repos.what: Cross-platform desktop app: press a hotkey, speak, and the text is pasted at your cursor. Also does meeting transcription and notes. Local models keep audio offline.

howTo.value: Download the release for your OS, or:
brew install --cask openwhispr

repos.reachFor: You want free WisprFlow-style dictation into any app, ideally fully offline.

repos.name: pdoom-video
repos.oneLiner: Three.js music video with word-synced karaoke typography
repos.what: A different code-rendered music video for the same song: TypeScript + three.js renderer, Demucs/CTC lyric alignment and beat analysis, scenes anchored to lyric lines. Every frame is a function of song time.

howTo.value:
cd app && bun install && bunx vite                       # live preview
bun scripts/render.ts video --samples auto --shutter 0.2 --out ../out/pdoom.mp4

repos.reachFor: You want a reference for audio-synced generative video (alignment, beat grid, offline render).

repos.name: mg-styles-15
repos.oneLiner: 15 motion-design styles with films, prompts and full source
repos.what: Fifteen 10-second films made by Claude Opus 5.5 writing code (SVG, Canvas, WebGL, Three.js, Blender), with style notes, prompts and source. Each film is a page exposing window.renderAt(t), captured in headless Chrome and joined with ffmpeg; soundtracks are synthesized by audio.py.

howTo.value: npm install and pip install -r requirements.txt at the root, then follow the per-demo render steps in the README.

repos.reachFor: You want reference prompts and a render harness for a specific motion-design look.

repos.name: ClaudeAnimationBase
repos.oneLiner: Starter kit for hand-painted cartoon animation with p5.js + p5.brush
repos.what: Code, an ANIMATION_GUIDE.md and the Clawd character (31 acted emotions) for having Claude storyboard, animate and render a cartoon to MP4. Needs Node, Chrome and ffmpeg; slow without a GPU.

howTo.value: Clone it, open in Claude Code and ask: Read ANIMATION_GUIDE.md, then make a 15-second video of Clawd .... To render the demo yourself:

npm install
node render.mjs --clip --out=out/video.mp4

repos.reachFor: You want painterly character animation made fully in code.

repos.name: PDoomVideo
repos.oneLiner: Source of the Claude-made "I'm Upping My P(doom)" music video
repos.what: Every scene of the music video, generated by Claude Opus 5.5 with p5 brushstrokes and the Clawd character, plus the storyboard and guide it used. The author's ClaudeAnimationBase is the reusable version.

howTo.value:
npm install
node render.mjs --frames=0:156.6 --workers=4
node render.mjs --encode --out=out/pdoom.mp4

repos.reachFor: You want to study how a long code-made music video was structured.

repos.name: awesome-claude-5-5-videos
repos.oneLiner: Field guide to Claude 5.5-era video workflows
repos.what: Source-linked tracker of hundreds of Claude-made video posts (Opus, Sonnet, Fable 5.2), with tooling and findings. What's inside: Fable 5.2 showcase, model selection guide, browse-by-model directory, empirical findings and a "make your own" section.
repos.reachFor: You are choosing a model or toolchain for code-made video and want evidence.

repos.name: pyCapCut
repos.oneLiner: Python library that generates CapCut drafts for automated editing
repos.what: Python library that writes CapCut draft projects (video, audio, text, stickers, keyframes, animations, effects, transitions, SRT import) so you can script editing or remix pipelines. It can also load a draft as a template and swap its media or text. You open the draft in CapCut and export by hand; it cannot export automatically. README is in Chinese, with an English version linked. The README warns that 0.1.0 will change the track API.

howTo.value: pip install pycapcut
Then follow demo.py in the repo: set your CapCut drafts folder path, run it, and open the new demo draft in CapCut.

repos.reachFor: you want to generate many CapCut timelines from code, for example batch subtitles or templated videos.

repos.name: ai-subtitles
repos.oneLiner: Next.js app that generates and styles subtitles with Whisper
repos.what: SubStudio: upload a video or link, transcribe with Whisper Large v3 on Together AI, edit and style the captions, export .srt, .vtt or burned-in .mp4.

howTo.value: Set TOGETHER_API_KEY in .env, then:

git clone https://github.com/Nutlope/ai-subtitles
cd ai-subtitles
npm install
npm run dev

repos.reachFor: You need quick styled captions for a clip, or a reference app for a Whisper transcription flow.

repos.name: luna
repos.oneLiner: Local video downloader and AI clipper for YouTube, Reels, TikTok
repos.what: Local web app (beta) for downloading video or MP3 from YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, keeping files in a workspace, trimming by timestamp, and turning long videos into short clips with AI (Gemini picks the moments, Groq Whisper or local Faster-Whisper transcribes). Has an MCP server so an agent can start clip jobs.

howTo.value: Downloads need no keys; add API keys in Settings only for AI clips.

# macOS / Linux, installs to ~/Luna
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miqdadbadjuber/luna/main/install.sh | sh
# later runs: ./start.sh inside ~/Luna

repos.reachFor: You want a local downloader plus a simple AI clipper without a subscription.

repos.name: ohmyzsh
repos.oneLiner: zsh config framework with plugins and themes
repos.what: A framework for your zsh config with 300+ plugins (git, docker, node...) and many themes.

howTo.value: sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)"
Then edit ~/.zshrc: set ZSH_THEME="..." and plugins=(git docker), and restart the shell.

repos.reachFor: setting up a new machine's shell.

repos.name: Understand-Anything
repos.oneLiner: Claude Code plugin that turns a codebase into an explorable knowledge graph
repos.what: A Claude Code plugin (also Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and others) that runs a multi-agent pass over your project and builds a knowledge graph of files, functions, classes and dependencies, with a dashboard to explore it and plain-English summaries per node.

howTo.value: inside Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything
/plugin install understand-anything
/understand
The graph is saved to .ua/knowledge-graph.json. First run on a big repo burns a lot of tokens.

repos.reachFor: onboarding onto a large unfamiliar codebase.

repos.name: Mole
repos.oneLiner: Mac/PC cleaner CLI (mo): clean, uninstall, analyze disk
repos.what: A free CLI (mo) that combines cache cleaning, app uninstalling with leftovers, a disk usage TUI and a live system status view.

howTo.value:
brew install mole
mo clean --dry-run     # preview first
mo clean
mo analyze             # disk explorer
mo uninstall
mo purge               # project build artifacts (node_modules, etc.)

repos.reachFor: your disk is full or you want CleanMyMac without paying.

repos.name: alacritty
repos.oneLiner: Minimal GPU-accelerated terminal
repos.what: A minimal, cross-platform, OpenGL terminal. No tabs or splits; pair it with tmux.

howTo.value: brew install --cask alacritty, then configure in ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml.

repos.reachFor: you want a fast, bare terminal and already use tmux.

repos.name: ghostty
repos.oneLiner: Fast native GPU terminal
repos.what: A fast GPU-accelerated terminal with native UI (tabs, splits) on macOS and Linux. Its core, libghostty, powers cmux and Ghostex.

howTo.value: brew install --cask ghostty, then put settings like theme = ... and font-family = ... in ~/.config/ghostty/config.

repos.reachFor: you want a native terminal with splits that is fast out of the box.

repos.name: typst
repos.oneLiner: Markup typesetting system, a modern LaTeX alternative
repos.what: A markup typesetting system, like LaTeX but with simpler syntax and instant compiles.

howTo.value:
brew install typst
typst compile doc.typ      # -> doc.pdf
typst watch doc.typ
Syntax: = Heading, *bold*, _italic_, #set text(font: "...").

repos.reachFor: writing papers, CVs or reports as code.

repos.name: insomnia
repos.oneLiner: API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets
repos.what: Desktop API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets and SSE, with local, Git or cloud storage for collections.

howTo.value: brew install --cask insomnia, create a collection, add requests and environments. The inso CLI runs collections in CI.

repos.reachFor: you want a Postman alternative that can store data locally or in Git.

repos.name: UTM
repos.oneLiner: Virtual machines on macOS/iOS (QEMU + Apple Virtualization)
repos.what: Runs virtual machines on macOS (and iOS) using QEMU or Apple's Virtualization framework. Linux, Windows ARM and older OSes.

howTo.value: brew install --cask utm (or download from the site), create a VM, attach an ISO, boot.

repos.reachFor: you need a free VM on Apple Silicon.

repos.name: vorssaint-utils
repos.oneLiner: Free menu bar toolkit replacing many paid Mac utilities
repos.what: One menu bar app with optional modules: per-app volume, system monitor, app switcher, window snapping, Dock previews, clipboard history, snippets, file shelf, uninstaller. No account or telemetry.

howTo.value: brew install --cask vorssaint, then pick only the features you want in setup.

repos.reachFor: you want to replace several paid menu bar utilities with one free app.

repos.name: husky
repos.oneLiner: Git hooks for JS projects
repos.what: Manages Git hooks (pre-commit, commit-msg, etc.) from your repo so the whole team runs them.

howTo.value:
npm install --save-dev husky
npx husky init   # creates .husky/pre-commit and a prepare script
Edit .husky/pre-commit to run what you want (e.g. npm test).

repos.reachFor: you want lint/test checks before every commit.

repos.name: squoosh
repos.oneLiner: In-browser image compressor
repos.what: A web app that compresses and resizes images in the browser with codecs like MozJPEG, WebP and AVIF, with a side-by-side preview.

howTo.value: open [squoosh.app](http://squoosh.app), drop an image, pick a codec and quality, download. Works offline as a PWA.

repos.reachFor: you need to shrink a few images by hand and compare quality.

repos.name: biome
repos.oneLiner: Fast formatter + linter for JS/TS/JSON/CSS
repos.what: One fast tool that formats and lints JS, TS, JSX, JSON and CSS. Mostly a drop-in for Prettier + ESLint.

howTo.value:
npm i -D -E @biomejs/biome
npx @biomejs/biome init
npx @biomejs/biome check --write ./src

repos.reachFor: you want faster formatting/linting with one config file.

repos.name: Ghost-Downloader-3
repos.oneLiner: Cross-platform download manager (HTTP, BT, M3U8, YouTube...)
repos.what: A PySide6 download manager for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. Handles HTTP, magnet/BitTorrent, FTP, M3U8, DASH and eD2k, plus YouTube/Bilibili and GitHub/Hugging Face downloads, with a browser extension that hands downloads to the app and an aria2-compatible RPC API.

howTo.value: download the installer for your OS from GitHub Releases (Arch has AUR packages). For scripting, install the ghd CLI from Settings → Command Line Tool, then e.g. ghd add and ghd tasks.

repos.reachFor: you want one free app for large files, torrents and video streams instead of several.

repos.name: semgrep
repos.oneLiner: Pattern-based static analysis / SAST
repos.what: Static analysis where rules look like the code you are searching for. Used for security scanning and custom lint rules across many languages.

howTo.value:
brew install semgrep        # or: pip install semgrep
semgrep scan --config auto

repos.reachFor: you need security checks or a custom pattern rule in CI.

repos.name: ast-grep
repos.oneLiner: Structural (AST) search, lint and rewrite CLI
repos.what: grep for syntax trees. Search, lint and rewrite code by structural pattern with $VAR metavariables.

howTo.value:
brew install ast-grep     # or: npm i -g @ast-grep/cli
ast-grep run -p 'console.log($A)' -l ts
ast-grep run -p 'console.log($A)' -r 'logger.info($A)' -l ts

repos.reachFor: a regex replace is too fragile for a codemod.

repos.name: kiri
repos.oneLiner: Light Docker Desktop/OrbStack replacement
repos.what: A small Rust container runtime that speaks the Docker Engine API, so docker, Compose and buildx work unchanged. VM sleeps when idle; also does local *.kiri.local domains, one-command Kubernetes and Linux machines.

howTo.value: install the .dmg/.msi/.deb from [runkiri.com/releases](http://runkiri.com/releases). It creates a kiri Docker context:

docker --context kiri run --rm alpine echo hello
kiri import        # bring images/volumes over from Docker Desktop or OrbStack
kiri k8s start

repos.reachFor: Docker Desktop is too heavy and you want an OrbStack-like free option.

repos.name: knip
repos.oneLiner: Finds unused files, deps and exports in JS/TS
repos.what: Finds unused files, dependencies and exports in JS/TS projects, with plugins for common frameworks.

howTo.value:
npm init @knip/config
npx knip

repos.reachFor: cleaning dead code and stale dependencies.

repos.name: pdfkit
repos.oneLiner: Generate PDFs in Node and the browser
repos.what: A PDF generation library for Node and the browser: text, vector graphics, images, fonts, links.

howTo.value: npm i pdfkit

repos.reachFor: building invoices or reports in JS without a headless browser.

repos.name: jscpd
repos.oneLiner: Copy/paste (duplicate code) detector, 220+ languages
repos.what: Copy/paste detector for 220+ languages. v5 is a Rust binary with extra passes for dead code, complexity and a health score, plus SARIF output, a GitHub Action and an MCP server.

howTo.value:
npx jscpd .
# or install: curl -fsSL https://jscpd.dev/install.sh | bash
jscpd . --baseline-from-ref origin/main --fail-on-new-clones 0

repos.reachFor: you want to find or block duplicated code.

repos.name: fallow
repos.oneLiner: JS/TS codebase health: dead code, duplication, complexity, cycles
repos.what: One Rust binary that builds a graph of a JS/TS repo and reports unused code, duplication, complexity hotspots, circular deps and architecture drift. audit only fails on issues a change introduces.

howTo.value:
npx fallow                  # health, duplication, unused code
npx fallow audit --base HEAD~15
npx fallow fix --dry-run
npx fallow viz              # interactive HTML map

repos.reachFor: you want a PR gate or a health overview of a TS codebase.

repos.name: opengrep
repos.oneLiner: Open-source SAST engine, Semgrep-rule compatible
repos.what: Open-source SAST engine forked from Semgrep, backed by several AppSec companies. Taint tracking across files, 30+ languages, runs Semgrep rules.

howTo.value: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opengrep/opengrep/main/install.sh | bash
Then run opengrep scan with your Semgrep-format rules file against a directory. There is also an agent skill: npx skills add opengrep/skills.

repos.reachFor: you want Semgrep-style scanning with no license limits.

repos.name: nextjs-starter-kit
repos.oneLiner: Next.js SaaS starter kit
repos.what: A Next.js SaaS boilerplate with auth, payments, database and UI already wired up.

howTo.value: clone the repo, install deps, fill .env from the example file with your provider keys, run the dev server.

repos.reachFor: starting a SaaS and you do not want to wire auth and billing yourself.

repos.name: pikepdf
repos.oneLiner: Read/edit PDFs in Python (QPDF wrapper)
repos.what: A Python library for reading, editing and writing existing PDFs, built on QPDF. Good at merging, splitting, page edits, metadata and repair.

howTo.value: pip install pikepdf

import pikepdf

with pikepdf.open('in.pdf') as pdf:
    del pdf.pages[0]
    pdf.save('out.pdf')

repos.reachFor: manipulating existing PDFs in Python (not drawing new ones).

repos.name: rollup-plugin-visualizer
repos.oneLiner: Treemap of what is in your Rollup/Vite bundle
repos.what: Generates an HTML treemap (or sunburst, network) of what is inside your bundle. Works with Rollup and Vite.

howTo.value: npm i -D rollup-plugin-visualizer
Build, and stats.html opens.

repos.reachFor: your bundle is too big and you need to see why.

repos.name: Insomnia
repos.oneLiner: Menu bar app to keep a Mac awake (lid closed) for a set time
repos.what: A menu bar app that keeps a MacBook awake, lid closed included, for a timed session, then undoes its changes. Experimental; installs a sudoers rule for pmset. Needs macOS 26+ on Apple Silicon.

howTo.value: ask your coding agent to follow the repo's skills/install-insomnia/SKILL.md, or build from source (./scripts/install.sh). Click the eye icon, enter a duration, press Enter.

repos.reachFor: a long agent run must keep going with the laptop closed.

repos.name: crab
repos.oneLiner: Clean-room rebuild of a feature from observed behavior, via MCP
repos.what: Clean Rebuild of Anything's Behavior. One agent observes an app as a black box and writes a sanitized behavior spec; a second agent, which only sees the spec, implements it. Early (0.4) and you own the legal call.

howTo.value:
uv tool install "crab-cleanroom[web]"
crab install-browser
crab demo
claude mcp add crab-observe -- crab observe --project /path/to/project

repos.reachFor: you want to reimplement a feature you like without copying its code.

repos.name: react-vite-starter
repos.oneLiner: React + Vite + Redux Toolkit + shadcn starter
repos.what: A React starter with Vite, Redux Toolkit + RTK Query, React Router, shadcn/ui, ESLint, commitlint and Testing Library preset.

howTo.value: clone it, npm install, npm run dev.

repos.reachFor: you want a ready React SPA template with that stack.

repos.name: open-design
repos.oneLiner: Local-first AI design agent workspace
repos.what: Open source (Apache 2.0) workspace where you start from a brief and have your coding agent or their cloud produce prototypes, sites, decks, dashboards and more, with shared design systems and templates.

howTo.value: curl -fsSL https://open-design.ai/install.sh | sh -s <agent>
Or clone the repo and run pnpm tools-dev run web for local development.

repos.reachFor: you want a Claude-Design-style workspace you can self-host and extend.

repos.name: react-bits
repos.oneLiner: Animated React components (JS/TS, CSS/Tailwind)
repos.what: Large library of animated and interactive React components (text effects, backgrounds, cursors...). Each comes in JS or TS and CSS or Tailwind; you copy the source into your project.

howTo.value: npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/SplitText-TS-TW

repos.reachFor: a page needs a striking text or background effect without writing it yourself.

repos.name: ai-website-cloner-template
repos.oneLiner: Next.js template + agent skill that rebuilds a site from its URL
repos.what: Next.js 16 + shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4 starter with a /clone-website skill. Given a URL, the agent maps routes, inspects desktop and mobile pages, extracts real assets and fonts, builds editable components, then compares against the source and fixes differences. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode; needs Node 24+.

howTo.value: Ask your agent to set the template up as a new project (clone, remove the origin remote, install, run npm run check), open it with browser access enabled, then:
/clone-website https://example.com

repos.reachFor: moving a site you own to Next.js, recovering lost source, or studying how a production layout is built.

repos.name: fullPage.js
repos.oneLiner: Full-screen section scrolling
repos.what: Library that turns a page into full-screen sections that snap on scroll, with horizontal slides inside sections. Wrappers for React and Vue; commercial use needs a license.

howTo.value: npm install fullpage.js
new fullpage('#fullpage', { licenseKey: 'YOUR_KEY' });

repos.reachFor: building a one-page site where each section fills the screen.

repos.name: Sortable
repos.oneLiner: Drag-and-drop reorderable lists
repos.what: Dependency-free library for reorderable lists and drag between lists, with touch support, animations and multi-drag.

howTo.value: npm install sortablejs

import Sortable from 'sortablejs';
Sortable.create(document.getElementById('list'), { animation: 150 });

repos.reachFor: you need sortable lists or kanban-style drag without a framework.

repos.name: awesome-shadcn-ui
repos.oneLiner: Curated list of shadcn/ui resources
repos.what: Awesome list of libraries, registries, themes, tools and templates around shadcn/ui. What's inside: Libs and Components, Registries, Plugins and Extensions, Colors and Customizations, Animations, Tools, Websites and Portfolios, Ports, Design System, Boilerplates / Templates. Searchable at [awesomeshadcn.dev](http://awesomeshadcn.dev).
repos.reachFor: you need a shadcn-compatible component or theme and want to see what exists.

repos.name: lenis
repos.oneLiner: Lightweight smooth scroll
repos.what: Smooth-scroll library from [darkroom.engineering](http://darkroom.engineering) that keeps native scroll behaviour (position: sticky, etc.) and pairs well with GSAP ScrollTrigger.

howTo.value: npm i lenis

import Lenis from 'lenis';
const lenis = new Lenis({ autoRaf: true });

repos.reachFor: a scroll-heavy site needs smooth, consistent scrolling.

repos.name: openui
repos.oneLiner: Open standard + framework for generative UI
repos.what: Full-stack generative UI framework built on OpenUI Lang, a compact streaming language that models emit to render real components. React, Vue, Svelte, Angular and LangGraph bindings.

howTo.value:
npx @openuidev/cli@latest create --name genui-chat-app
# or in an existing React app
npm install @openuidev/react-lang @openuidev/react-ui

repos.reachFor: an LLM chat should answer with interactive components instead of plain text.

repos.name: fumadocs
repos.oneLiner: React docs framework (Next.js, Astro, Vite)
repos.what: Framework for documentation sites: MDX content, search, sidebar, theming. Supports Next.js, Astro and Vite-based setups (TanStack Start, React Router, Waku). ESM only.

howTo.value: npm create fumadocs-app

repos.reachFor: you need a docs site for a library or product.

repos.name: canvas-confetti
repos.oneLiner: Confetti animation in the browser
repos.what: Small canvas-based confetti effect with options for particle count, spread, origin and shapes; respects reduced motion if you ask it to.

howTo.value: npm install canvas-confetti

import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 70 });

repos.reachFor: celebrating a success state (signup, payment, completion).

repos.name: liquid-glass-react

repos.what: React component that renders Apple-style Liquid Glass with refraction, frost level and hover/click effects around any children.

howTo.value: npm install liquid-glass-react
Wrap your content in the LiquidGlass component and tune props like frost and refraction mode (see README).

repos.reachFor: you want the iOS 26 glass look on a card or button.

repos.name: figcraft

repos.what: Native desktop app for interface design and prototyping: frames, auto layout, components and variants, variables, prototypes, plus a collaboration server. Works offline.

howTo.value:
git clone https://github.com/storytold/figcraft
cd figcraft
cargo run --release -p figcraft

repos.reachFor: you want a local, open alternative to Figma or are curious how one is built.

repos.name: react-rnd
repos.oneLiner: Resizable + draggable React component
repos.what: React component that makes any child both draggable and resizable, with bounds, grid snapping and controlled position/size.

import { Rnd } from 'react-rnd';
<Rnd default={{ x: 0, y: 0, width: 320, height: 200 }}>Box</Rnd>

repos.reachFor: building editors, dashboards or window-like panels users can move and resize.

repos.name: anatomy
repos.oneLiner: Interactive 3D human anatomy explorer
repos.what: three.js demo app for exploring human anatomy in 3D. The README is just the vinext starter it was built on (Node 22.13+).

howTo.value:
npm install
npm run dev

repos.reachFor: you want a three.js reference for an interactive 3D explorer.

repos.name: stisla

repos.what: Component library built on one set of design tokens (color, spacing, radius, type). Started as a Bootstrap admin template; docs, demos and templates live at [stisla.dev](http://stisla.dev).

repos.reachFor: you need a clean admin/dashboard starting point.

repos.name: blocks

repos.what: Open-source shadcn/ui registry of marketing sections (heroes, features, pricing...), shipped for both Base UI and Radix UI.

Add the @tailark-oss namespace to components.json first (see README).

repos.reachFor: assembling a shadcn landing page from ready sections.

repos.name: magic-portfolio
repos.oneLiner: Next.js portfolio template (Once UI)
repos.what: Beginner-friendly portfolio with MDX projects and blog, an about/CV page and SEO, built on Once UI.

howTo.value:
git clone https://github.com/once-ui-system/magic-portfolio.git
cd magic-portfolio && npm install && npm run dev

repos.reachFor: you want a clean personal portfolio fast.

repos.name: dialkit
repos.oneLiner: Live control panel to tune UI values
repos.what: Floating panel that lets you tweak values (radius, color, spring timing...) in a running app and compare versions. React, Solid, Svelte, Vue and vanilla adapters.

howTo.value: npm install dialkit motion

repos.reachFor: dialing in spacing, colors or animation timing by feel instead of edit-reload.

repos.name: mvpblocks
repos.oneLiner: Copy-paste Next.js + Tailwind blocks for MVPs
repos.what: Open-source collection of Next.js / Tailwind / Framer Motion blocks (landing, dashboard, portfolio sections) you preview and copy from the site.

repos.reachFor: you need a quick MVP UI and want copyable shadcn-style sections.

repos.name: svelte-svg-patterns
repos.oneLiner: Pattern Monster: seamless SVG pattern generator
repos.what: Source of [pattern.monster](http://pattern.monster), a Svelte app with 320+ seamless SVG patterns; tweak colors, stroke and angle, then copy CSS/SVG or download PNG.

howTo.value: open [pattern.monster](http://pattern.monster), pick a pattern, adjust, copy the CSS background.

repos.reachFor: you need a subtle tiled background or header pattern.

repos.name: voler
repos.oneLiner: Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard template
repos.what: Free admin template on Bootstrap 5 with no jQuery. The author now points to the newer Mazer template.

howTo.value: git clone https://github.com/zuramai/voler
Open dist/index.html in a browser.

repos.reachFor: you need a plain HTML/Bootstrap admin layout.

python paper_writing_cli.py ...   # arguments listed in README

repos.reachFor: quick whiteboarding, or embedding a drawing canvas in your app.
